reading.title: The Discovery of Exoplanets
reading.passage: The discovery of exoplanets has fundamentally transformed astronomy. Since the first exoplanet discovery in 1995, astronomers have identified over 5,000 planets orbiting distant stars. These discoveries employ the transit method, which detects the slight dimming of starlight when a planet passes in front of its host star. This technique has revealed diverse planetary systems, challenging previous assumptions about planetary formation. Some exoplanets exist in the habitable zone, where liquid water might exist, suggesting the possibility of extraterrestrial life.

questions.q: According to the passage, how do astronomers detect exoplanets?
options: By observing the brightness increase of stars
By detecting the dimming of starlight as planets pass in front of stars
By measuring gravitational waves from distant planets
By analyzing radio signals from extraterrestrial sources
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '이 기술은 행성이 모성 앞을 지날 때 별빛이 약간 어두워지는 것을 감지한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about planetary systems?
options: All exoplanets are similar to Earth
Planetary systems are more diverse than previously believed
Exoplanets cannot support any form of life
Most exoplanets orbit the same star
questions.explanation: 지문이 '이 발견들은 행성 형성에 대한 이전의 가정에 도전하는 다양한 행성계를 드러냈다'고 언급하고 있으므로, 행성계가 이전 생각보다 더 다양함을 추론할 수 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? 'Governments should implement stricter immigration policies to prioritize their own citizens' employment and welfare.' Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 도입부: 이민 정책에 대한 명확한 입장을 제시하세요. 예: 'In my opinion, while protecting citizens is important, completely restrictive immigration policies may be counterproductive. I believe immigration should be regulated thoughtfully rather than strictly limited.'
structure.body1: 본론 1: 경제적 관점에서의 예시. 예를 들어, 이민자들이 특정 산업 (의료, 기술)에서 숙련된 노동력을 제공하는 방법, 또는 스타트업과 혁신에 기여하는 방식을 구체적으로 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 본론 2: 사회문화적 이점 또는 균형 잡힌 접근의 필요성. 예를 들어, 다양성이 경제 성장을 촉진하는 방법, 또는 선별적 이민 정책이 본국민 보호와 이민자 수용을 동시에 가능하게 하는 방식을 제시하세요.
structure.conclusion: 결론: 주장을 재진술하고 요약하세요. 예: 'In conclusion, rather than implementing overly strict policies, governments should adopt balanced immigration strategies that protect citizens while recognizing immigrants' contributions to economic growth and innovation.'

key_phrases: In my opinion, I believe that
Furthermore, it is important to consider
On the other hand, some argue that
In conclusion, a balanced approach is necessary
It is undeniable that immigration contributes to
This suggests that selective policies would be more effective

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer shopping online for convenience and variety. Others prefer shopping in physical stores for personal experience and immediate purchase. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer shopping online because
One reason is that online shopping offers convenience
For example, I can browse products at any time
Additionally, there are often better deals and discounts
On the other hand, some people enjoy the in-store experience
To sum up, online shopping better suits my lifestyle
sample_points: 온라인 쇼핑의 편의성: 언제 어디서나 쇼핑 가능, 배송 서비스, 더 많은 선택지
매장 쇼핑의 이점: 직접 제품 확인 가능, 즉시 구매 가능, 개인적 쇼핑 경험
개인의 라이프스타일에 맞는 선택을 명확히 하고, 구체적 예시(시간 절약, 비용 절감 등)를 제시

listening.title: Dormitory Room Assignment Inquiry
listening.script: Student A: Hi, I'm calling about my dormitory room assignment. I haven't received my assignment letter yet, and classes start next week. Housing Officer: Let me check your information. What's your name and student ID? Student A: My name is James Chen, student ID 45789. Housing Officer: Thank you. I see your application here. Unfortunately, we're experiencing delays due to high enrollment this year. Student A: Oh no, when can I expect to receive my assignment? Housing Officer: We should process all assignments by Friday. However, if you'd like, I can place you in temporary housing immediately so you're not without accommodation. Student A: That would be helpful. Will I have to move rooms later? Housing Officer: Possibly, but it ensures you have a place during the first week. We'll prioritize finding you permanent housing quickly. Student A: Okay, that sounds reasonable. Thank you for your help.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: To discuss the quality of dormitory facilities
To inquire about and resolve a dormitory room assignment delay
To complain about the housing application process
To request a transfer to a different dormitory
questions.explanation: 학생이 아직 기숙사 배정 통지서를 받지 못했다는 문제를 주택 담당자에게 문의하는 대화입니다.

questions.q: What does the housing officer suggest to the student?
options: To wait until the following month for permanent housing
To contact the admissions office about the delay
To accept temporary housing immediately until permanent assignment is available
To choose a different dormitory building
questions.explanation: 주택 담당자는 학생에게 '임시 주거에 먼저 배치할 수 있으므로 첫 주 동안 숙박 시설이 없는 일이 없을 것'이라고 제안합니다.

questions.q: Why does the housing officer mention that enrollment is high this year?
options: To explain why dormitory fees are increasing
To explain the reason for delays in processing room assignments
To encourage the student to find off-campus housing
To justify why temporary housing is of lower quality
questions.explanation: 주택 담당자는 높은 입학 인원이 기숙사 배정 처리 지연의 원인이라고 설명합니다.
